summary: Module 3: PyTorch coupled spatiotemporal model. Contains CoupledConvLSTMCell (ConvLSTM with peephole connections), FeedbackCouplingModule (physics-informed PM2.5/AOD → delta-Temp and delta-PBL computation using non-linear sigmoid/tanh constraints), and AirPollutionCoupledForecaster (72-step autoregressive rollout with feedback injection at each step, spatial attention, and a lightweight decoder head per output channel).
